why_ai: Fans pay to watch specific human athletes compete in person, which AI cannot substitute; the business side is more exposed than the product.
why_clarity: Wins, attendance and revenue are measured exactly, but player projection and coaching run on feel and are graded slowly.
why_digital: The product is a live game in a physical venue, though tickets, media and sponsorship are increasingly sold and delivered digitally.

why_ai: Partnerships are sold and renewed through executive relationships and negotiation that AI tools support but do not replace.
why_clarity: Signed fees and renewals are clear, but pricing and proof are done by precedent and each deal is bundled differently.
why_digital: Proposals, contracts and measurement are digital, while signage, hospitality and the selling itself are local and in person.

why_ai: Comparables and valuation ranges are screen work that data platforms automate; the final ask stays a negotiation.
why_clarity: A quoted value can be checked against the signed fee, though deals are few per club and confidential.
why_digital: Deal data, audience measures and valuation models are digital, sold to clubs that still buy through relationships.

why_ai: Delivery tracking and recaps automate; credible outcome proof depends on a negotiated data relationship with the sponsor.
why_clarity: Delivery against contract is countable, but outcome lift needs partner data and a control group and arrives once a term.
why_digital: Exposure, logs and recaps are digital, with renewal conversations held in person.

why_ai: Rights, carriage and distribution choices are high-stakes negotiations under a collapsing market, with live production crews behind them.
why_clarity: Subscribers, households and revenue are measurable, but each club's rights decision is a one-off made every few years.
why_digital: Streams, ratings and subscriptions are digital, while rights and carriage are negotiated locally with distributors and leagues.

why_ai: Scouts watch teenagers in person across rural ballparks and foreign academies, and the projection is a novel, high-stakes judgement with years-slow feedback.
why_clarity: Grades follow a shared scale, but each scout reads players differently and outcomes arrive four to seven years later.
why_digital: The input is a player seen in person and the relationship with his family is local; only the report itself is digital.

why_ai: Corporate suite buyers pay for hospitality and a relationship with the club, delivered in the building.
why_clarity: Inventory under contract is exact, but renewals come every three to ten years and depend on the holder's business.
why_digital: The product is an in-person suite experience sold through tours, dinners and local relationships.

why_ai: A small club sells a family evening at a local ballpark, run by game-day staff and rooted in its community.
why_clarity: Seventy home dates a season recur with attendance and revenue known each night, though promotions are planned by feel.
why_digital: Tickets sell online, but the product, the selling and the sponsorships are local and in person.

why_ai: Cap and NIL decisions carry compliance liability and depend on relationships with athletes and families under new, contested rules.
why_clarity: Cap compliance is exact, but retention and fair value are judged case by case under a regime only a year old.
why_digital: Ledgers and deal submissions are digital, while recruiting and retention are face to face on campus.

why_ai: Per-game forecasts and price recommendations are standard machine-learning work that pricing platforms automate.
why_clarity: Each game's price is graded by sales and resale within days across dozens of near-identical dates.
why_digital: Schedules, sales and resale prices in, price recommendations out, all online.

why_ai: Segmenting and labelling plays from video and tracking is pattern work that computer vision increasingly does.
why_clarity: Tags are checked by the coaching staff the same day across thousands of near-identical plays, though each staff's vocabulary differs.
why_digital: Game film and tracking data in, tagged clips out, all on screen.

why_ai: Charting and grading from film is moving to computer vision; the vendors' protection is their archive and club relationships.
why_clarity: Every play is charted to a defined scheme across thousands of games, though grades embed analysts' judgement.
why_digital: Film in, event data and grades out, sold remotely to clubs.

why_ai: Logo detection and media valuation are screen work that computer vision and AI-native tools replicate.
why_clarity: Measurement repeats every game, but the value attached to exposure rests on modelled assumptions and rarely meets an outcome.
why_digital: Broadcasts and posts in, reports out, sold and delivered remotely.

why_ai: A deal database and AI analyst are product work that AI-native competitors can approach, protected by the audited archive.
why_clarity: Deal records are defined and updated continuously, though estimated values are checked only when fees leak.
why_digital: Venue audits and scraped data in, an online database out, sold remotely.

why_ai: League consultants advise member clubs through trusted relationships on business questions that vary by market.
why_clarity: Benchmarks are clear across clubs, but each club's consulting engagement differs and results show over seasons.
why_digital: Pooled club data in, benchmarks and advice out, with club visits and league meetings.

why_ai: Compliance advice carries accountability under a new regime, though cap ledgers and deal packages automate.
why_clarity: Cap rules and deal reviews are defined and recur per deal, though fair-value judgements are contested.
why_digital: Contracts and deal data in, ledgers and submissions out, all online.

why_ai: Sensors go on athletes in person and readiness calls involve medical staff, which keeps part of the work protected.
why_clarity: Load metrics recur daily, but injury outcomes are rare and confounded, so feedback is slow.
why_digital: Sensor data from athletes' bodies in, dashboards out, sold through club performance staff.

why_ai: On-campus sales teams sell signage and hospitality through local relationships with brands and schools.
why_clarity: Sponsorship sales and renewals are countable, but each school's inventory and market differ.
why_digital: Signage, radio and hospitality are delivered on campus and sold locally, with data kept centrally.

why_ai: Camera systems in venues and league contracts protect the business more than the analysis does.
why_clarity: Tracking output is exact, repeated every game and checked immediately against video.
why_digital: Venue cameras capture physical play; feeds and graphics are delivered digitally.

why_ai: Minority stakes in clubs are illiquid, high-stakes bets that rest on relationships with owners and league approval.
why_clarity: Returns are measurable but arrive after six-year holds, and each club is a one-off.
why_digital: Financial data is digital, but deals are won through owners and league offices in person.

why_ai: The group runs physical ballparks and local front offices; central services support them.
why_clarity: Club revenues and attendance are measured nightly and recur across dozens of clubs.
why_digital: Central reporting is digital, but the clubs' products and sales are local.

why_ai: Club sales rest on relationships with owners and leagues and on judgement in rare, high-stakes deals.
why_clarity: Each transaction is bespoke and its success is judged on a closing years in the making.
why_digital: Valuations and memoranda are digital, while processes run through in-person meetings with owners and leagues.

why_ai: The commission's decisions are enforcement acts made by accountable people under a settlement, which keeps them human-signed.
why_clarity: Deal reviews follow defined rules and recur hundreds of times a day, though fair-value calls are contested.
why_digital: Deals are submitted and decided online.

why_ai: Live production crews are physical, but the business is being replaced by league-run and direct-to-consumer media.
why_clarity: Ratings, carriage and ad revenue are measured game by game.
why_digital: Telecasts and audience data are digital, with carriage negotiated with regional distributors.

why_ai: Studies are signed by named principals for public financing votes, with site visits and stakeholder interviews.
why_clarity: Methods are standard, but each study is bespoke and its forecasts are rarely checked after the venue opens.
why_digital: Site and market data in, reports out, sold to cities and clubs through local presentations.

why_ai: Bargaining research serves members through a trusted union, in adversarial negotiations with leagues.
why_clarity: Bargaining outcomes are clear but come once per agreement, and survey research is contested.
why_digital: Contracts and surveys are digital, with bargaining done face to face.
